title: I'm creating a monster tamer RPG, and this is how it's coming along so far! - Ninefir
author: TheKamiBoy
selftext:
Ninefir: The Black Book is an action RPG set in an ancient world filled with mysterious creatures to discover, capture, and tame. It features real-time combat, exploration, quests, character progression, equipment, different builds, and hundreds of creatures, all wrapped in a minimalist pixel-art style.

This is a project I've wanted to bring to life for years, but it was only with the recent advancements in AI that I was finally able to turn the idea into an actual game, especially when it comes to programming. As a solo developer, AI has become a tool that helps me bridge the gaps in areas outside my main expertise and actually build the world I've had in my head for so long.

The world, creatures, stories, and even its fictional language have been something I've been creating and developing for years.

What do you guys think? I'm open to any tips and suggestions!

comments.author: Kiko_Production
comments.body:
Wow it seems really good, especially how constant your style. The ui hud is amazing. However locations looks kinda empty, maybe you should place more decals like trees, bushes. Animations feels great but projectiles need more polishing as they looks boring. 

Nice job!

replies.author: TheKamiBoy
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback! I’m definitely going to add more things to the environment, especially bushes.

As for the projectiles, I agree with you. I need to think of a way to improve them.
